home.heading: Master the six Russian cases
home.intro: Study the declension rules case by case, then practise them with games.
home.offline: The app’s server isn’t responding; exercises won’t load.

rules.title: Rules
rules.text: What each case is for, its endings in every declension, and the exceptions.

endings.title: Endings
endings.text: Drag each word onto the ending it takes in the chosen case. Practice or arcade.

sentences.title: Sentences
sentences.text: Read a sentence, work out which case the word needs, then pick its ending.

level.personal_pronouns: Personal (я, ты, он… → меня́, мне, мной)

modes.arcadeHint: Words fall faster and faster. 3 lives.

game.empty: No words match these settings. The dictionary form itself is never asked (e.g. the nominative singular), so try another case or level.
game.failed: Couldn't load words. Please try again.
game.howTo: Drag a word onto its ending, or tap the word and then the ending. Keys 1–9 work too.

summary.title: Results
summary.loginToSave: to keep track of your progress.

game.soloHint: Played on its own: you drop words onto whole forms instead of endings.

practice.title: Words
practice.fewerKnownWords: Show words I know less often
practice.fewerKnownWordsAbout: A word you got right the last 3 times in a case comes up 4 times less often in that case. After a mistake it comes up as often as the others again.

speech.title: Pronunciation
speech.about: Hear words and examples spoken by the voice “Irina”. This needs the speech pack (about 70 MB), downloaded once.
